AboutPage.title: About Two Two Eight Co., Ltd (TTEC)
AboutPage.subtitle: Two Two Eight Co., Ltd (TTEC) is one of the leading companies specializing in the supply of safety and explosion-proof equipment used in high-risk and harsh industrial environments such as oil & gas, petroleum, paint manufacturing, and mineral mining industries like coal, metal, and more. Since 2006, 228 Vietnam has built a professional organizational structure with a passionate, dynamic, creative, and highly qualified team.
AboutPage.message1: THE PRODUCT LINES CURRENTLY DISTRIBUTED BY TWO TWO EIGHT CO., LTD (TTEC) ARE DESIGNED FOR INDUSTRIAL, HARSH, HAZARDOUS, AND EXPLOSION-PRONE ENVIRONMENTS, INCLUDING:

products.explosionProofDeskPhone: Desk phones: explosion-proof and industrial grade
products.wiredPhoneSystem: Wired phones and communication systems: for harsh conditions
products.paSystem: Industrial and explosion-proof public address systems
products.explosionProofMobilePhone: GSM mobile phones: explosion-proof and industrial
products.dataCollector: Data collection devices: Pocket PCs, PDAs, and accessories for hazardous, harsh, and explosion-prone environments
products.explosionProofLaptop: Notebooks and laptops: for industrial, hazardous, and explosion-proof environments
products.lightingDevices: Lighting devices: flashlights, work lights, headlamps (miner's lamps)... used in oil & gas, mining, and explosion-prone industries
products.industrialLighting: Fluorescent and LED lighting systems: industrial and explosion-proof
products.controlAndConnectivity: Industrial and explosion-proof control and connectivity devices
products.switchgearsAndMotors: Industrial and explosion-proof switchgears and motors

AboutPage.message2: With the mission to deliver cutting-edge technology, high safety standards, and quality technical services to our customers, we are currently the official distributor in Vietnam for globally renowned manufacturers such as: Guardian Telecom Inc. (Canada), ECOM Instruments GmbH (Germany), ENTEL UK Limited (UK), HADAR (UK), CorDEX Instruments (UK), MARECHAL (France), RIG-A-LITE (USA), and others. Two Two Eight Co., Ltd (TTEC) is a trusted partner offering consulting, design, equipment supply, turnkey solutions, system integration, technical services, and training to various government agencies, enterprises, and organizations in Vietnam, including:
